official.application_route: Electronic application through the UB e-government portal (seu.ub.edu) with prior authentication; once confirmed the application cannot be modified.
official.international_eligibility: No nationality restriction is published in the convocatoria; holders must however be enrolled with a DNI or NIE rather than a passport, which is the practical gate for foreign applicants.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must be enrolled in a UB master's programme linked to the specific scholarship, and the awards are tied to a consolidated research group; the specific requirements and merits are given in the annex to each scholarship.
official.research_requirement: Beneficiaries are integrated into a research group and their activities are tied to the activities organised by that consolidated research group and to the realisation of the project presented under the direction of a tutor.
official.duration: One academic year (2026/2027); the payment is proportional to the period during which the collaboration is actually provided.
official.description: The Programe Master+ UB is a collaboration scholarship programme aimed at attracting students of good academic record to study official master's degrees at the University of Barcelona and at encouraging scientific vocations within a research group. Beneficiaries join a consolidated research group and carry out activities tied to that group's work and to a project presented under a tutor's direction, in return for an hourly retribution.
official.program_type: Research collaboration scholarships attached to a UB official master's programme

applicant_utility.summary: Master+ UB is not a classic scholarship: it buys your collaboration hours inside a consolidated research group at a published tariff of EUR 6.35 per hour, with monthly gross retributions running from EUR 275.33 at 10 hours a week to EUR 688.80 at 25 hours a week. You must already be enrolled full-time in the specific UB master's the award is attached to, and you sign acceptance with a DNI or NIE, never a passport - the single most common disqualifier for foreign applicants. Tuition funding is not promised: the convocatoria only says the call may cover the matricula of some master's depending on each centre's budget, so treat any fee waiver as a bonus and the hourly pay as the substance. The programme runs twice a year, in April and October, so a closed round is not the end of the road.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Full-time students already admitted to a UB official master's who want paid research-group experience and can navigate the Catalan-language e-government portal.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure admission to the specific UB master's linked to the scholarship before the window opens, since enrolment is a condition of acceptance
Switch your enrolment record from passport to DNI or NIE well before signing, by contacting the relevant Secretaria
Read the annex to the call for your particular scholarship, because the specific requirements and merits sit there rather than on the main page
Check you have not held a collaboration scholarship at the same unit, faculty, external entity or the IDP in the previous twenty-two months
Prepare to authenticate through seu.ub.edu rather than sending anything by email or post
Line up a tutor and a project inside the target research group, since your work is defined by that group's activity
common_rejection_risks: Being enrolled with a passport instead of a DNI or NIE, which blocks you from signing acceptance at all
Not being a new-access, full-time student on the linked master's at the moment of acceptance
Holding a recent collaboration scholarship at the same unit, faculty, external entity or the IDP within the previous twenty-two months
Assuming tuition is covered - the convocatoria only permits it subject to each centre or research group's budget
Trying to amend the application after confirmation, which the portal does not allow
Applying to a master's that is not on the scholarship's annex list
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Most or all of the master's tuition fee, since fee funding is discretionary; standard UB master's fees are roughly EUR 2,500 to EUR 3,300 for a 60-credit programme. The retribution is also taxable, with 2% IRPF withholding and employee social security deducted.
document_audit: The document list lives in basis IV of the convocatoria and its annex, not on the public Master+ pages - request it from the Beques i Ajuts a l'Estudiant office rather than guessing
Applicants with foreign qualifications must use the published nota mitjana estudis estrangers note to convert their average mark
The matricula is the proof of student status, so an offer without enrolment does not hold
alerts: There are two editions a year, April and October; the published 2026/2027 first call closed on 26 June 2026, and no October date had been posted at the time of checking
An extension resolution (Termini Ampliat) has been published for this round, so confirm the operative dates on the sol-licitud page before assuming a window has closed
Payment is proportional to the period actually collaborated, so late enrolment means reduced retribution
The pages are in Catalan; use the language toggle or machine translation rather than assuming the English catalogue entry matches the call
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Authenticate on seu.ub.edu, complete the electronic application for the call, attach the basis IV documentation, confirm (no changes afterwards), then enrol with a DNI or NIE and sign acceptance before being placed with a research group and tutor.
